`fail`、来歴なし、入力／ランナー変更後の結果は成功に数えません。複数の結果の和集合は
独立した検証環境での確認数であり、一つのシミュレータの適合率ではありません。

複数テストで一つの要求を分担する `check_groups` は、同じ実行環境・実行回で
グループ内の全テストが成功した場合に限り成功とします。未指定の対応は独立した代替証拠です。

### SV2023-2-EXTRACT-DATED-REFERENCES

2 / normal / テスト未対応

When applying a dated normative reference, use the edition explicitly identified by IEEE 1800-2023.

合格基準: Referenced algorithms and interfaces follow the specified dated edition; do not silently substitute a different edition.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-2-EXTRACT-UNDATED-REFERENCES

2 / normal / テスト未対応

An undated normative reference denotes the current edition together with amendments and corrigenda.

合格基準: Resolve an undated normative dependency when applying the relevant referenced rule; no particular later publication is invented by this inventory.

規定の性質: `definition`。

### SV2023-3.14.1-EXTRACT-LOCAL-ROUNDING-INDEPENDENCE

3.14.1 / normal / 実行確認あり

A finer precision elsewhere in the design does not increase the accuracy of a delay already rounded in another design element.

合格基準: A finer precision elsewhere in the design does not increase the accuracy of a delay already rounded in another design element.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

- [test_time_value_rounding.sv](../tests/ch3/test_time_value_rounding.sv): The fine instance and top have 1ps precision but do not refine the coarse instance 100ps-rounded delays; coarse and fine expected outputs are checked together.

### SV2023-3.14.1-EXTRACT-RELATIVE-DECIMAL-RESOLUTION

3.14.1 / normal / 実行確認あり

Decimal resolution is the ratio of local time precision to local time unit.

合格基準: A precision ten times finer than the unit retains one fractional decimal digit; corresponding powers of ten determine other resolutions.

規定の性質: `definition`。

- [test_time_value_rounding.sv](../tests/ch3/test_time_value_rounding.sv): The ratio 100ps/1ns is0.1 local units; sub-resolution 0.04 rounds to zero and 0.06 to0.1, while the 1ps instance resolves three fractional digits.

### SV2023-3.14.1-EXTRACT-ROUND-LOCAL-PRECISION

3.14.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A delay is rounded to its design element's time precision before it is scheduled.

合格基準: With unit 1ns and precision 100ps, 2.75ns rounds to 2.8ns; equal unit/precision rounds to integer local units.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

3.14.2.1 / normal / 実行確認あり

The most recently encountered timescale directive supplies the active directive setting until another such directive changes it.

### SV2023-3.14.2.1-EXTRACT-TIMESCALE-UNIT-BOUNDARY

3.14.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A timescale directive is restricted to its current compilation unit and does not cross separately compiled unit boundaries.

合格基準: A timescale directive is restricted to its current compilation unit and does not cross separately compiled unit boundaries.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-COMBINED-TIMEUNIT

3.14.2.2 / normal / 実行確認あり

A timeunit declaration may additionally specify precision as a second time literal after a slash.

合格基準: A timeunit declaration may additionally specify precision as a second time literal after a slash.

規定の性質: `permission`。

- [test_timeunit_with_precision.sv](../tests/ch3/test_timeunit_with_precision.sv): The combined slash declaration overrides the preceding timescale, and both printtimescale and accumulated fractional delay show the declared 100ps unit/10ps precision.

### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-INITIAL-TIME-DECLARATION-ORDER

3.14.2.2 / error / テスト未対応

The initial timeunit/timeprecision declarations in a time scope must precede its other items.

合格基準: Reject the first declaration of a local time setting when it follows another item in that time scope.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-LOCAL-TIME-DECLARATIONS

3.14.2.2 / normal / 実行確認あり

timeunit and timeprecision declarations each take a time literal for the corresponding local setting.

合格基準: timeunit and timeprecision declarations each take a time literal for the corresponding local setting.

規定の性質: `definition`。

- [test_time_value_rounding.sv](../tests/ch3/test_time_value_rounding.sv): Separate local unit and precision declarations give the coarse and fine modules their distinct delay quantization; observable fractional delays distinguish the settings.

### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-LOCAL-TIME-INDEPENDENCE

3.14.2.2 / normal / テスト未対応

Explicit local time declarations remove dependence on preceding timescale directive order for those local settings.

合格基準: Explicit local time declarations remove dependence on preceding timescale directive order for those local settings.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-MATCHING-REPETITION

3.14.2.2 / normal / テスト未対応

A timeunit or timeprecision declaration may recur later in the same time scope only if it matches the earlier declaration.

合格基準: Accept matching later declarations and reject a conflicting repeated setting.

規定の性質: `permission`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.2-EXTRACT-TIME-SCOPE-SETTINGS

3.14.2.2 / normal / テスト未対応

A module, program, package, interface or compilation-unit time scope has at most one effective unit value and one effective precision value.

合格基準: Reject conflicting effective declarations within one time scope; matching repeated declarations are handled by the explicit repetition rule.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-IMPLEMENTATION-TIME-DEFAULT

3.14.2.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Default time unit and default precision are implementation-specific.

合格基準: Treat the documented/selected defaults as parameters; do not assert a universal numeric default.

規定の性質: `implementation_defined`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-MIXED-TIME-SPECIFICATION

3.14.2.3 / error / テスト未対応

It is an error for some design elements to have specified time unit/precision while others do not.

合格基準: Reject an incompletely specified mixture under the rules for inherited/directive/local settings.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-TIME-PRECISION-PRECEDENCE

3.14.2.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Absent an explicit local precision, apply the same inheritance/directive/compilation-unit/default precedence used for time units.

合格基準: Absent an explicit local precision, apply the same inheritance/directive/compilation-unit/default precedence used for time units.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-TIME-UNIT-PRECEDENCE

3.14.2.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Absent an explicit local unit, a nested module/interface inherits its enclosing module/interface unit; otherwise use the latest preceding in-unit timescale, then compilation-unit timeunit, then the implementation default.

合格基準: Apply that priority chain without substituting a later directive or unrelated scope; the stated nesting cases govern inheritance.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-UNIT-TIME-DEFAULT

3.14.2.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Without a compilation-unit timeunit declaration, the compilation-unit scope uses the implementation default time unit.

合格基準: Without a compilation-unit timeunit declaration, the compilation-unit scope uses the implementation default time unit.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-3.14.2.3-EXTRACT-UNIT-TIMEUNIT-ONLY

3.14.2.3 / normal / テスト未対応

The compilation-unit scope's time unit is set only by its timeunit declaration, not by a timescale directive.

合格基準: A timescale directive does not redefine $unit's time unit.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.3-EXTRACT-GLOBAL-TIME-PRECISION

3.14.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Global time precision is the minimum duration among all timeprecision declarations, precision arguments of timeunit declarations, and timescale precisions in the design.

合格基準: Compute the minimum across all three specified sources, not just the top module's local setting.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-3.14.3-EXTRACT-STEP-NO-SCOPE-SETTING

3.14.3 / error / テスト未対応

The step unit cannot set or modify a time scope's unit or precision.

合格基準: Reject a declaration that uses step to set timeunit or timeprecision.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-3.14.3-EXTRACT-STEP-SCALE

3.14.3 / normal / テスト未対応

The step time unit denotes the global time precision.

合格基準: The step time unit denotes the global time precision.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-CONCURRENT-PROCESSES

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Concurrent process constructs preserve their specified independent state and sensitivity while being scheduled concurrently.

合格基準: Concurrent process constructs preserve their specified independent state and sensitivity while being scheduled concurrently.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-PLI-EVALUATION

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Scheduled PLI callbacks participate in the simulation model as evaluation events at their specified control points.

合格基準: Scheduled PLI callbacks participate in the simulation model as evaluation events at their specified control points.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-REFERENCE-EQUIVALENCE

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

A simulator must produce user-visible effects consistent with the standard discrete-event reference algorithm.

合格基準: Alternative internal algorithms are allowed only when their observable outcomes are among those allowed by the reference model.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-REGION-ORDERING

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Events in one simulation time slot are ordered by their prescribed scheduling regions so sampling, checking and testbench reaction can coexist with zero/nonzero delays.

合格基準: Preserve each construct's assigned region and the reference algorithm's iteration semantics.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-SENSITIVITY-EVALUATION

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

Applying an update event makes every process sensitive to that event eligible for evaluation; their relative evaluation order is not generally fixed.

合格基準: Honor construct-specific sensitivity filters and do not impose a source-order guarantee across unrelated eligible processes.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.3-EXTRACT-UPDATE-EVENT

4.3 / normal / テスト未対応

A change to a simulated net or variable is an update event.

合格基準: A change to a simulated net or variable is an update event.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4-EXTRACT-DRAIN-TIME-SLOT

4.4 / normal / テスト未対応

All events belonging to the current time slot are processed before advancing to the next nonempty time slot.

合格基準: All events belonging to the current time slot are processed before advancing to the next nonempty time slot.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.4-EXTRACT-EVENT-LIFECYCLE

4.4 / normal / テスト未対応

The simulator maintains event state supporting dynamic scheduling, execution and removal as simulation time advances.

合格基準: No particular linked-list representation is mandated, but scheduled events cannot be lost or executed twice.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.4-EXTRACT-MONOTONIC-TIME

4.4 / normal / テスト未対応

Simulation time advances to successive nonempty slots in increasing time order and never goes backward.

合格基準: Simulation time advances to successive nonempty slots in increasing time order and never goes backward.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-4.4-EXTRACT-ONE-EVENT-TIME

4.4 / normal / テスト未対応

Each scheduled event has exactly one execution time, equal to the current time or a future time.

合格基準: An event may not be scheduled into a simulation time preceding the current time.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4-EXTRACT-ORDERED-REGIONS

4.4 / normal / テスト未対応

A time slot orders its regions as Preponed, Pre-Active, Active, Inactive, Pre-NBA, NBA, Post-NBA, Pre-Observed, Observed, Post-Observed, Reactive, Re-Inactive, Pre-Re-NBA, Re-NBA, Post-Re-NBA, Pre-Postponed and Postponed.

合格基準: Use that region sequence together with the explicitly specified iteration loops, not a single-pass scheduler.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4.1-EXTRACT-ACTIVE-SET

4.4.1 / normal / テスト未対応

The active-region set contains Active, Inactive, Pre-NBA, NBA and Post-NBA.

合格基準: The active-region set contains Active, Inactive, Pre-NBA, NBA and Post-NBA.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4.1-EXTRACT-ITERATIVE-SET

4.4.1 / normal / テスト未対応

The iterative regions run from Active through Pre-Postponed, excluding Preponed, Pre-Active and Postponed.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4.1-EXTRACT-REACTIVE-SET

The reactive-region set contains Reactive, Re-Inactive, Pre-Re-NBA, Re-NBA and Post-Re-NBA.

合格基準: The reactive-region set contains Reactive, Re-Inactive, Pre-Re-NBA, Re-NBA and Post-Re-NBA.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4.2-EXTRACT-SIMULATION-REGION-SET

4.4.2 / normal / テスト未対応

Simulation regions are Preponed, Active, Inactive, NBA, Observed, Reactive, Re-Inactive, Re-NBA and Postponed.

合格基準: Simulation regions are Preponed, Active, Inactive, NBA, Observed, Reactive, Re-Inactive, Re-NBA and Postponed.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-4.4.2.1-EXTRACT-ONE-STEP-SAMPLE

A #1step sample obtains the value immediately before the current time slot, equivalent to current Preponed or previous Postponed sampling.

合格基準: Do not sample a value already changed in the current Active/NBA/Reactive processing.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

### SV2023-6.24.1-EXTRACT-ASSIGNMENT-CAST-EQUIVALENCE

6.24.1 / normal / 実行確認あり

An assignment-compatible explicit type cast yields the value a variable of that type would hold after assignment from the expression, equal to its implicit conversion.

- [test_cast_byte.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_byte.sv): Casts 100,300,-50 to byte and checks100,44,-50, the values that byte assignment would store. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_shortint.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_shortint.sv): Casts1000,12345678h,-100 to shortint and checks1000,5678h,-100. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_longint.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_longint.sv): Casts positive and negative int to longint with preserved sign; the large direct longint assignment is not misclassified as a cast. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_real.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_real.sv): Converts positive42,negative100 and zero to real with exact expected values. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_real_basic.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_real_basic.sv): Converts42,-10 and100 to real with exact expected values. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_ext.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_ext.sv): Observes both narrowing/sign extension and real conversion, including3.9->4,-2.5->-3 and the sum of two rounded casts. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_operations.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_operations.sv): Converts real3.7 to nearest int4, also checks predefined shortint/longint and real casts. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_enum.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_enum.sv): An enum with explicit int base value-10 casts to int-10; also checks enum integer encodings via explicit int casts. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.
- [test_cast_expr_2.sv](../tests/ch6/test_cast_expr_2.sv): Checks positive/negative real-to-int rounding and named integral type truncation/extension, whose expected values match destination assignment conversion. This is a concrete value-conversion witness, not exhaustive coverage of every type pairing.

- [test_queue_reference_persistence.sv](../tests/ch7/test_queue_reference_persistence.sv): Delayed ref writes distinguish a surviving element after push_front, an element removed by delete, and a second element whose reference becomes outdated after whole-queue concatenation assignment. Task-local outdated values remain accessible but do not update the current queue.

### SV2023-10.4.2-EXTRACT-ORDERED-NBA-UPDATES

10.4.2 / normal / テスト未対応

When nonblocking assignment executions have a defined order, their updates to a given destination at the same update time preserve that order.

合格基準: When nonblocking assignment executions have a defined order, their updates to a given destination at the same update time preserve that order.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.4.2-EXTRACT-TWO-PHASE-NBA

10.4.2 / normal / テスト未対応

Nonblocking assignment separates value evaluation/scheduling from the later destination update under Chapter 4 event regions.

合格基準: Nonblocking assignment separates value evaluation/scheduling from the later destination update under Chapter 4 event regions.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.5-EXTRACT-INITIALIZATION-NOT-DRIVER

10.5 / normal / テスト未対応

A variable declaration assignment initializes storage and does not establish an implicit continuous driver.

合格基準: A variable declaration assignment initializes storage and does not establish an implicit continuous driver.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.5-EXTRACT-INITIALIZED-STORAGE-RETAINS

10.5 / normal / テスト未対応

A variable declaration initializer sets a value retained until a subsequent assignment, rather than a continuing assignment with duration.

合格基準: A variable declaration initializer sets a value retained until a subsequent assignment, rather than a continuing assignment with duration.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.5-EXTRACT-STATIC-BEFORE-PROCEDURES

10.5 / normal / テスト未対応

A static variable declaration initializer, including static class members, is applied before any initial/always procedures start.

合格基準: A static variable declaration initializer, including static class members, is applied before any initial/always procedures start.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.5-INITIALIZE-ONCE

10.5 / normal / 実行確認あり

A declaration initializer is a one-time procedural initialization.

合格基準: The captured variable stays 7 after its source changes to 40.

- [test_declaration_initialization_is_not_driver.sv](../tests/ch10/test_declaration_initialization_is_not_driver.sv): The captured variable stays 7 after its source changes to 40.

### SV2023-10.6-EXTRACT-PROCEDURAL-CONTINUOUS-DEFINITION

10.6 / normal / テスト未対応

Procedural assign/force establish continuously driven expressions on permitted variable/net targets.

合格基準: Procedural assign/force establish continuously driven expressions on permitted variable/net targets.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-10.6-EXTRACT-PROCEDURAL-CONTINUOUS-GRAMMAR

10.6 / normal / テスト未対応

The grammar permits variable assign/deassign, net/variable force/release and their required lvalue/expression forms.

合格基準: The grammar permits variable assign/deassign, net/variable force/release and their required lvalue/expression forms.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-10.6-EXTRACT-PROCEDURAL-CONTINUOUS-REEVALUATION

10.6 / normal / テスト未対応

While procedural assign/force remains active, changes to RHS input expressions cause reevaluation as for continuous assignment.

合格基準: While procedural assign/force remains active, changes to RHS input expressions cause reevaluation as for continuous assignment.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.1-EXTRACT-ASSIGN-OVERRIDE

10.6.1 / normal / テスト未対応

Procedural assign overrides ordinary procedural assignments to its variable until deassign.

合格基準: Procedural assign overrides ordinary procedural assignments to its variable until deassign.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.1-EXTRACT-ASSIGN-TARGET

10.6.1 / error / テスト未対応

Procedural assign requires a singular whole variable or concatenation of variables and cannot target variable bit/part selections.

合格基準: Procedural assign requires a singular whole variable or concatenation of variables and cannot target variable bit/part selections.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.1-EXTRACT-DEASSIGN-RETENTION

10.6.1 / normal / テスト未対応

deassign ends the procedural continuous driver; the variable retains its current value until a subsequent permitted assignment.

合格基準: deassign ends the procedural continuous driver; the variable retains its current value until a subsequent permitted assignment.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.1-EXTRACT-REASSIGN-REPLACES

10.6.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A new procedural assign on an already assigned variable first deassigns the previous procedural continuous assignment.

合格基準: A new procedural assign on an already assigned variable first deassigns the previous procedural continuous assignment.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-FORCE-NET-OVERRIDE

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

A net force overrides all its gate/module/continuous drivers until release.

合格基準: A net force overrides all its gate/module/continuous drivers until release.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-FORCE-TARGETS

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

force/release permit whole singular variables/nets, constant bit/part selections of eligible vector nets and concatenations of these.

合格基準: force/release permit whole singular variables/nets, constant bit/part selections of eligible vector nets and concatenations of these.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-FORCE-VARIABLE-OVERRIDE

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

A variable force overrides procedural, continuous and procedural-assign drivers until release.

合格基準: A variable force overrides procedural, continuous and procedural-assign drivers until release.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-NO-FORCE-MIXED-DRIVEN-VARIABLE

10.6.2 / error / テスト未対応

force/release cannot target a variable driven by a mixture of continuous and procedural assignment.

合格基準: force/release cannot target a variable driven by a mixture of continuous and procedural assignment.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-NO-FORCE-VARIABLE-SELECT

10.6.2 / error / テスト未対応

force/release cannot select bits/parts of variables or inside user-defined nettype nets.

合格基準: force/release cannot select bits/parts of variables or inside user-defined nettype nets.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-RELEASE-CONTINUOUS-RESTORES

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

Releasing a variable with an active continuous/procedural-assign driver restores that driver and schedules reevaluation in its continuous assignment region.

合格基準: Releasing a variable with an active continuous/procedural-assign driver restores that driver and schedules reevaluation in its continuous assignment region.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-RELEASE-NET-RESOLVES

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

A net release immediately restores the value determined by its drivers.

合格基準: A net release immediately restores the value determined by its drivers.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.6.2-EXTRACT-RELEASE-UNDRIVEN-RETAINS

10.6.2 / normal / テスト未対応

After release, a variable without an active continuous/procedural-assign driver retains its forced value until the next procedural assignment.

合格基準: After release, a variable without an active continuous/procedural-assign driver retains its forced value until the next procedural assignment.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.7-EXTRACT-DETERMINE-SIZES

10.7 / normal / テスト未対応

Assignment first determines both operand widths using the standard expression sizing rules.

合格基準: Assignment first determines both operand widths using the standard expression sizing rules.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-10.7-EXTRACT-LHS-CONTEXT

10.7 / normal / テスト未対応

The LHS size supplies assignment context to the RHS under expression-sizing rules.

合格基準: The LHS size supplies assignment context to the RHS under expression-sizing rules.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

Constant system and built-in method calls used in constant expressions are evaluated during elaboration.

合格基準: Constant system and built-in method calls used in constant expressions are evaluated during elaboration.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-FUNCTION-FAMILIES

11.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

Eligible conversion/math/bit-vector/$sformatf calls with constant arguments are constant system calls; data/array queries may qualify with nonconstant arguments under 20.6/20.7.

合格基準: Eligible conversion/math/bit-vector/$sformatf calls with constant arguments are constant system calls; data/array queries may qualify with nonconstant arguments under 20.6/20.7.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-METHOD-PURE

11.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A constant built-in method must be a side-effect-free function dependent only on inputs/current receiver value, without modifying the receiver.

合格基準: A constant built-in method must be a side-effect-free function dependent only on inputs/current receiver value, without modifying the receiver.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-METHOD-RECEIVER

11.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A qualifying method with constant receiver and inputs is constant; if it does not depend on receiver value, constant inputs suffice even for a nonconstant receiver.

合格基準: A qualifying method with constant receiver and inputs is constant; if it does not depend on receiver value, constant inputs suffice even for a nonconstant receiver.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-OPERANDS

11.2.1 / error / テスト未対応

Constant expressions permit only constant numbers/strings/parameters, constant parameter selections, nonvoid constant functions and eligible constant system/built-in method calls, using the defined operators.

合格基準: Constant expressions permit only constant numbers/strings/parameters, constant parameter selections, nonvoid constant functions and eligible constant system/built-in method calls, using the defined operators.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-SYSTEM-PURE

11.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

A constant system function is pure: its return depends only on its inputs and it has no side effects.

合格基準: A constant system function is pure: its return depends only on its inputs and it has no side effects.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-11.2.1-EXTRACT-CONSTANT-TIMESCALE-NAME

11.2.1 / normal / テスト未対応

The timescale constant-function list in 11.2.1 names $timescale and $timeprecision, while 20.4 lists $timeunit and $timeprecision. The first name is pending source interpretation before accepting a constant-function test.

合格基準: The timescale constant-function list in 11.2.1 names $timescale and $timeprecision, while 20.4 lists $timeunit and $timeprecision. The first name is pending source interpretation before accepting a constant-function test.

未解決の解釈: `CONSTANT-TIMESCALE-NAME`（対応承認・節完了を保留）。

Unless specified otherwise, an unrecognized pragma name has no effect on source interpretation.

合格基準: Unless specified otherwise, an unrecognized pragma name has no effect on source interpretation.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

- [test_pragma_unrecognized.sv](../tests/ch22/test_pragma_unrecognized.sv): Unknown names before and inside the module, including nested argument values, leave source interpretation and computed 2*21 unchanged.

### SV2023-22.11.1-EXTRACT-PRAGMA-RESET

22.11.1 / normal / テスト未対応

The reset pragma restores affected pragma names listed as keywords to their tool state before any source was processed; resetall resets every recognized pragma name.

合格基準: The reset pragma restores affected pragma names listed as keywords to their tool state before any source was processed; resetall resets every recognized pragma name.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.12-EXTRACT-LINE-ARGUMENTS

22.12 / error / テスト未対応

line requires a positive integer line number, string-literal absolute/relative filename and level 0/1/2, meaning ordinary line/include entry/include exit respectively.

合格基準: line requires a positive integer line number, string-literal absolute/relative filename and level 0/1/2, meaning ordinary line/include entry/include exit respectively.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.12-EXTRACT-LINE-DIRECTIVE

22.12 / error / テスト未対応

Compilers maintain current filename/line; line sets the following line location, takes all three required arguments, may occur anywhere, allows only whitespace on its line, forbids same-line comments, and survives resetall.

合格基準: Compilers maintain current filename/line; line sets the following line location, takes all three required arguments, may occur anywhere, allows only whitespace on its line, forbids same-line comments, and survives resetall.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.12-EXTRACT-LINE-PRODUCTION-OPTIONAL

22.12 / normal / テスト未対応

Tools need not emit line directives; manually supplied directives are permitted.

合格基準: Tools need not emit line directives; manually supplied directives are permitted.

規定の性質: `permission`。


### SV2023-22.12-EXTRACT-LINE-TRACKING

22.12 / normal / テスト未対応

Compilers increment location per line, start files at line 1 and store/restore parent locations across includes; updated locations are PLI-accessible and line does not alter library search.

合格基準: Compilers increment location per line, start files at line 1 and store/restore parent locations across includes; updated locations are PLI-accessible and line does not alter library search.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.13-EXTRACT-FILE-MACRO

22.13 / normal / テスト未対応

__FILE__ expands to a string literal containing the path used to open the input file, rather than merely the short include/input spelling; path format may be implementation-dependent.

合格基準: __FILE__ expands to a string literal containing the path used to open the input file, rather than merely the short include/input spelling; path format may be implementation-dependent.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.13-EXTRACT-INCLUDE-LOCATION-MACROS

22.13 / normal / テスト未対応

Includes switch FILE/LINE expansions to included input; returning restores parent filename and its include-line number plus one.

合格基準: Includes switch FILE/LINE expansions to included input; returning restores parent filename and its include-line number plus one.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.13-EXTRACT-LINE-MACRO

22.13 / normal / 実行確認あり

__LINE__ expands to the current input line as a simple decimal number.

合格基準: __LINE__ expands to the current input line as a simple decimal number.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

- [test_line_directive.sv](../tests/ch22/test_line_directive.sv): The line-number macro is used as a decimal expression on consecutive lines after remapping to 500; the second observed value is 501.

### SV2023-22.13-EXTRACT-LINE-OVERRIDES-MACROS

22.13 / normal / 実行確認あり

line changes LINE expansion and may change FILE expansion.

合格基準: line changes LINE expansion and may change FILE expansion.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

- [test_line_directive.sv](../tests/ch22/test_line_directive.sv): A line directive changes both current line and filename macros; the immediately following line prints 500 and the renamed file.

### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-CUSTOM

22.14 / error / テスト未対応

Custom version specifiers are permitted, but an unrecognized specifier is an error.

合格基準: Custom version specifiers are permitted, but an unrecognized specifier is an error.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-DEFAULT

22.14 / normal / テスト未対応

Without begin_keywords, the implementation-dependent default keyword set applies; implementations may supply other mechanisms for selecting defaults.

合格基準: Without begin_keywords, the implementation-dependent default keyword set applies; implementations may supply other mechanisms for selecting defaults.

規定の性質: `implementation_defined`。


### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-PAIR

22.14 / error / テスト未対応

begin_keywords and end_keywords must be paired in that order to delimit the selected reserved-word set.

合格基準: begin_keywords and end_keywords must be paired in that order to delimit the selected reserved-word set.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-SCOPE

22.14 / error / テスト未対応

Keyword directives are permitted only outside design elements, span following files until the matching end, and survive resetall.

合格基準: Keyword directives are permitted only outside design elements, span following files until the matching end, and survive resetall.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-STACK

22.14 / normal / テスト未対応

Nested keyword pairs restore the preceding version on each matching end_keywords.

合格基準: Nested keyword pairs restore the preceding version on each matching end_keywords.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-22.14-EXTRACT-KEYWORD-VERSIONS

22.14 / normal / テスト未対応

規定の性質: `definition`。

### SV2023-23.3.3.7-EXTRACT-COLLAPSE-DEFINITIONS

23.3.3.7 / normal / テスト未対応

A dominated port net may merge with its dominating net, adopting the dominating type; the merged net is simulated and the dominated net collapsed.

合格基準: A dominated port net may merge with its dominating net, adopting the dominating type; the merged net is simulated and the dominated net collapsed.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7-EXTRACT-DOMINATING-DELAY-STRENGTH

23.3.3.7 / normal / テスト未対応

The simulated net uses its dominating net delay, and its trireg strength if the dominating type is trireg.

合格基準: The simulated net uses its dominating net delay, and its trireg strength if the dominating type is trireg.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7-EXTRACT-EXTERNAL-FALLBACK

23.3.3.7 / normal / テスト未対応

A merged dissimilar-type connection uses an applicable dominating type or external type; without a dominating type it shall use the external type.

合格基準: A merged dissimilar-type connection uses an applicable dominating type or external type; without a dominating type it shall use the external type.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7-EXTRACT-SELECTED-DELAY-STRENGTH

23.3.3.7 / normal / テスト未対応

The simulated net uses the table-selected type and that net delay; a selected trireg also supplies its specified strength.

合格基準: The simulated net uses the table-selected type and that net delay; a selected trireg also supplies its specified strength.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7.1-EXTRACT-INTERCONNECT-MERGE

23.3.3.7.1 / normal / テスト未対応

Any port connection involving interconnect shall merge its connected nets.

合格基準: Any port connection involving interconnect shall merge its connected nets.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7.1-EXTRACT-INTERCONNECT-TYPE

23.3.3.7.1 / normal / テスト未対応

Two interconnect nets merge as interconnect; one interconnect and one other type merge as the other type.

合格基準: Two interconnect nets merge as interconnect; one interconnect and one other type merge as the other type.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7.1-EXTRACT-NO-RESIDUAL-INTERCONNECT

23.3.3.7.1 / error / テスト未対応

At elaboration end, no simulated net may retain interconnect type.

合格基準: At elaboration end, no simulated net may retain interconnect type.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.7.2-EXTRACT-INTERCONNECT-TERMINAL

23.3.3.7.2 / normal / テスト未対応

An interconnect attached to a primitive or UDP terminal is treated as a scalar wire connection.

合格基準: An interconnect attached to a primitive or UDP terminal is treated as a scalar wire connection.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.8-EXTRACT-PORT-SIGNEDNESS

23.3.3.8 / normal / テスト未対応

Signedness does not cross hierarchy and must be declared at each level; port expressions are typed/sized/evaluated and assigned by ordinary assignment rules.

合格基準: Signedness does not cross hierarchy and must be declared at each level; port expressions are typed/sized/evaluated and assigned by ordinary assignment rules.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.3.3.8-PORT-SIGNEDNESS

23.3.3.8 / normal / 実行確認あり

The port declaration determines the signedness of values used inside the module.

合格基準: The same actual bits extend as fe through a signed formal and 0e through an unsigned formal.

### SV2023-23.4-EXTRACT-NESTED-IMPLICIT-INSTANCE

23.4 / normal / テスト未対応

An uninstantiated nested module without ports gets one implicit instance named after its module; one with ports is ignored.

合格基準: An uninstantiated nested module without ports gets one implicit instance named after its module; one with ports is ignored.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.4-EXTRACT-NESTED-OUTER-SCOPE

23.4 / normal / テスト未対応

合格基準: A nested module can use unhidden outer names if declared and instantiated in that same scope.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-23.5-EXTRACT-EXTERN-HEADER

23.5 / normal / テスト未対応

extern module declares a module name and ANSI or non-ANSI ports, optionally parameters, without a body.

規定の性質: `definition`。


### SV2023-23.5-EXTRACT-EXTERN-SCOPE-MATCH

- [test_package_import_program_header.sv](../tests/ch26/test_package_import_program_header.sv): The program header import supplies word_t before its port declaration, and a program initial observes value5 and width4. The module remains active until time1. This is a member of a collective witness; it does not independently cover all three design-element forms.

Enabled gates permit zero/one/two/three delays: none zero; one all transitions; two rise/fall with their minimum for x/z; three rise/fall/z with their minimum for x.

合格基準: Enabled gates permit zero/one/two/three delays: none zero; one all transitions; two rise/fall with their minimum for x/z; three rise/fall/z with their minimum for x.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-28.6-EXTRACT-THREE-STATE-KEYWORDS

28.6 / normal / テスト未対応

合格基準: Bufif0/bufif1/notif0/notif1 model three-state drivers capable of z output.

規定の性質: `definition`。

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

### SV2023-38.15-EXTRACT-UDP-SYMBOL-ORDER-TEXT

38.15 / normal / テスト未対応

UDP symbol-order text says most significant byte of abit, least significant byte of abit, most significant byte of bbit, then least significant byte of bbit; the field names and byte/word granularity need interpretation before an exact packing oracle.
